certificates.title: Check a certificate
certificates.text: Drop a certificate saved from About this answer, its proof, or both, with any file it may name. Or drop a picture, a film or a document to read how it was made. Nothing you give leaves this page.
certificates.unreadable: This isn’t a certificate of an answer, its proof, or a file that says how it was made.
certificates.broken: Changed, or not sealed by the key it names
certificates.where.device: Done on the device that sealed it
certificates.where.outside: Sent outside the device that sealed it
certificates.where.unknown: Where it was done isn’t certified
certificates.notLogged: Not in the public log it names
certificates.credentials: {name} carries a signed record of how it was made, unchanged since
certificates.credentialsBroken: {name} carries a record of how it was made that doesn’t hold: changed since, or not signed by the key it names
certificates.notAi: It doesn’t say AI made it
certificates.unbound: Whether the file changed since isn’t checked here
certificates.noRecord: {name} carries no record of how it was made
certificates.marks: {name} says how it was made, unsigned: anyone could have written it
certificates.watermark.match: Its invisible watermark is the one this record names
certificates.watermark.other: Its invisible watermark isn’t the one this record names
certificates.watermark.fetch: To look for an invisible watermark, this page first downloads its reader from {host}, then keeps it in this browser
certificates.words: Or paste words to look for the watermark of the brain on a device
certificates.words.marked: These words carry the watermark of the brain on a device: it wrote them, or someone made them look so
certificates.words.none: No watermark of the brain on a device found in these words, which doesn’t prove it didn’t write them
certificates.words.short: Too few words to tell: paste a page or so
certificates.words.fetch: To look for the watermark in words, this page first downloads its reader from {host}, then keeps it in this browser
certificates.failed: The reader couldn’t be downloaded from {host}. Try again later.
certificates.trust.trusted: Certified by an authority your organization trusts
certificates.trust.unchecked: Certified by an authority your organization trusts, with no proof it wasn’t revoked
certificates.trust.untrusted: Not certified by an authority your organization trusts
certificates.trust.revoked: Its certificate was revoked before this was sealed
certificates.qualified: A qualified seal under EU law
